coordinate_contract.command_angle_policy: The documented joint and motion commands accept degrees or explicit angle expressions. Convert exactly once from the native radian representation at a command boundary.
coordinate_contract.frame_policy: Bind each axis and origin from the reviewed native assembly. Do not reuse v7 IDs or infer a camera frame from the scene.

admission_requirements.check: Acquire the actual improved native source.
admission_requirements.acceptance: Record an HTTPS provenance source that identifies the candidate native file as the author's improved SELENE showcase. A filename, GIF, command list or matching feature count alone cannot establish identity.

admission_requirements.check: Pin and verify the source bytes.
admission_requirements.acceptance: Record the real repository/path/commit when repository-backed, actual download URL, SHA-256, byte length and native format. Verify bytes against the reviewed source record; reject every legacy_sources hash marked ineligible.

Record license expression, reviewer, date, supporting HTTPS evidence and applicable notices for the original model and any derivative helper geometry. Preserve Ubuntu Light lettering provenance when that geometry remains.

admission_requirements.check: Inspect the assembly without guessing bindings.
admission_requirements.acceptance: Record native component, occurrence, joint, motion-link and study identities, units, parentage, grounded roots, limits and any contact settings. Verify uniqueness and connectivity against the actual native file; leave ambiguous matches unresolved.

Complete the native review in motion/mechanism-acceptance.json. Explain legitimate differences from the demonstrations. Do not admit a renamed v7 or automatically admit an arbitrary file because its shape or counts look similar.

A reviewer sets active_source.status to pinned_native only after identity, provenance, bytes, license and native bindings are approved. Pending source locks cannot compile source-dependent scene or motion resources. Never fall back to a legacy source.

A pinned source is not a replay or physics result. Runtime motion needs a recorded SolidCraft revision, command inputs, tolerances, source digest, solved poses, stop/contact reports and review. Changed source bytes invalidate dependent bindings and recordings.
